# Knowledge-graph pre-check (generated by `python -m src.analysis.kg_precheck`)

Dataset v3; weekly head anomalies, training + validation weeks only; 1669 well pairs with >= 104 common weeks; 385 Pliocene–Pliocene pairs. `r_partial` = correlation after removing the plain-wide median anomaly. QAP permutation p-values (labels permuted across wells, 999 permutations): pairs share wells, so ordinary p-values would be too small.
